fogxy.config.title: Fog
fogxy.config.enabled: Constrain fog to the terrain edge
fogxy.config.enabled.tooltip: Makes Voxy's fog finish where the loaded terrain ends in each direction, and moves the fog start inward from there, so the ragged edge of explored terrain stays hidden. When off, Voxy's fog is left as it is.
fogxy.config.fog_start.tooltip: How far toward the terrain border the fog begins to fade in, as a percentage. The distance is measured in the world, so it's tied to the border rather than to where you stand. Higher values keep more of the view clear.
fogxy.config.fog_end.tooltip: How far toward the terrain border the fog becomes fully opaque, as a percentage. At 100% the fog ends right at the border. Lower values bring it closer to you.
fogxy.config.smooth.tooltip: How many rays are averaged together to work out the distance to the terrain edge. Higher values blend visible banding between directions into one smooth gradient. At 0, smoothing is off.
fogxy.config.slope.tooltip: The most the fog end can change between neighboring directions, in blocks. When your view grazes the edge of a gap, the fog end can jump suddenly and draw a sharp vertical line. Lower values spread that jump over a wider area. At 0, there's no limit.
fogxy.config.debug_gradient.tooltip: Tints the terrain to show what the fog shader is calculating. Red is the loop's distance divided by 2000, green is the fog amount wherever a hole's volume applies, and blue is the patch edge divided by 2000. Not meant for normal play.
fogxy.config.debug_edges.tooltip: Draws the fog shader's inner workings on top of the fog. Each hole is outlined in pink, its fog edge in purple, the fog block around it in orange, and pixels painted by the void fill in cyan. Not meant for normal play.
fogxy.config.hole_reach.tooltip: How far, in blocks, the fog block extends past a coarse patch so that it also covers the terrain right around it. The block is a volume in the world that fills the patch's footprint from floor to ceiling. It doesn't stretch along your line of sight.
fogxy.config.hole_fade.tooltip: How far, in blocks, the patch block fades out beyond its reach. Higher values give a softer, more gradual edge. At 0, the edge is hard.
fogxy.config.levels.tooltip: How many of Voxy's finest LOD levels count as terrain. Only the finest levels end close to the detailed terrain. Coarser levels stretch for kilometers, so counting more of them pushes the fog much farther away.
fogxy.config.hole_fill.tooltip: When Voxy has drawn no geometry at all inside a hole surrounded by loaded terrain, this fills the gap with solid fog instead of leaving a see-through patch of sky. It only applies to inland holes. The open sky beyond the terrain edge is left alone.
fogxy.config.fill_top.tooltip: The world height, in blocks, that the fill reaches. Set it close to the height of the terrain around your holes. Higher values fill more of the sky above a hole when you look across it. Lower values can leave a sliver of sky at the top of a hole seen from far away.
fogxy.config.sky_fog.tooltip: Colors the fog in each direction using the sky's own sunrise and sunset gradient, instead of the single color vanilla picks from wherever the camera is pointing. At dawn and dusk, wide views shade from sunset orange near the sun to plain sky color away from it, so the fog blends into the sky. When off, vanilla's camera-based color is used.
